scope: Android 1.2026.293 Remote input/task controls, static focused evidence; no build/device/backend mutations

verified_core_contracts.behavior: Submit hgk(text, attachments, gtk permission selection, fsk Queue or Steer). Stop dispatches separate bgk event. mck presence is suppressed for ram variant; fsk input passed only if p9 enabled; stop retained only if p8 && !sam. Smali verifies branching but upstream meanings of p8/p9/vam variants remain partially unnamed.
verified_core_contracts.minimum_implementation: Per-thread draft and selected supported queue/steer mode; preserve separate stop-active-turn action, no implicit stop on enqueue.

verified_core_contracts.owner: mz81 PendingReplyOverlay -> yz81 container/pill -> zrk menu -> omm reducer

events.fdk(id): edit pending: find ID; require xz81.l; ownership-dependent retain/edit identity vs local removal, then restore draft through v.P
events.sck(id): cancel/remove: owner-dependent backend coroutine vs cleanup attachments and remove local entry
events.agk(id): steer queued: require Queue, U checks matching host and current thread before changing mode and submitting
events.xfk(id): retry when phase numeric4; server-owned phase1 routes separate send coroutine
events.zdk(id,offset): reorder server-owned via coroutine, local via repository.o

verified_core_contracts.minimum_implementation: Use immutable pending ID + host/thread scope; separate queue state from transcript completion; expose edit/cancel/steer/retry/reorder by explicit capabilities; never settle by text equality.
verified_core_contracts.gate_detail: urk b/c edit/cancel; d steer; e/f movement; g/h retry/send. yz81 derives state/ownership/capability flags; full phase enum semantics not proven.

verified_core_contracts.owner: plk.a chooses model slider or gpm menu; gpm model submenu; olk commitPendingReasoningEffort
verified_core_contracts.behavior: ipm capabilities Model/Speed/Reasoning. gpm includes reasoning choices only for Reasoning capability, speed submenu only Speed; model list and optional Other models supplied by metadata. jq0 enumerates null(default),fast,ultrafast with support/current selection filtering; decompiler suspicious on exact filter, do not hard-enable all.
verified_core_contracts.minimum_implementation: Render supplied models, effort levels and speed capabilities; independent selection state; avoid hardcoded model catalog.

verified_core_contracts.behavior: Menu takes caller-provided allowed gtk list. itk enum Default, AutoReview, ReadOnly, FullAccess, CustomConfig; custom config invariant nonnull iff CustomConfig.
verified_core_contracts.minimum_implementation: Render only allowed presets from current connection; preserve custom preset metadata; selection travels in hgk. Permission-to-backend approval/sandbox conversion not traced.

verified_core_contracts.owner: qy81.p optional rg1 -> z4m.a Goal chip; j5q -> z4m.c Goal panel and z4m.b editor -> f37/mn6
verified_core_contracts.behavior: Editor has text input and cancel/save, panel shows goal and action callbacks. w4m implements thread/goal/set and thread/goal/clear.
verified_core_contracts.minimum_implementation: Per-thread goal text editor/panel with explicit save/cancel/clear and result/error state, enabled only supplied goal capability. No claim of autonomous continuation from local fixture save.

verified_core_contracts.owner: /status yul -> status formatting oej0; account/rateLimits/read ijj and updated h0q0
verified_core_contracts.behavior: Resource describes status as thread id,directory,context usage,rate limits. oej0.m includes optional Agents field formed from newline-joined entries; this is a status display, not evidence of agent creation/management UI.
verified_core_contracts.minimum_implementation: Read-only status sheet from fixture/backend snapshot with context/limit values; optional agent list when present. Do not invent agent management/create controls.

limitations: No original backend or runtime parity validation.
Large JADX qy81/omm/yz81 branches have warnings; only focused composer construction and menu capability guards corroborated by bytecode.
Exact vam semantic names, all pending phase values, edit retention semantics, service-owned acknowledgements and cancellation race behavior not fully resolved.
Full models/effort/speed metadata producer and current capability availability unverified.
Goal feature gates and lifecycle continue/pause/clear meanings require further owner/event mapping.
Standalone Agents entry/navigation not established; only /status data field proved.
Exact Android menu layout, labels, colors, touch geometry and full usage-sheet route not reconstructed here.

smali_corroboration.confirms: sam/tam/ram tests; ram suppresses mck path; optional fsk p9; mck construction; stop p8 && !sam; separate e9 case8; yak construction
Independent menu guards b,d,g-or-h,e,f,c; validates capability-gated actions rather than unconditional menu
